objective: Independent integrity review of the existing GOAL-SATIC-c49b77 launch archives (BATCH-1a527c, BATCH-971dc7, BATCH-cef2eb) with an early startup receipt and a durable final report.

joints.name: archive_artifact_integrity
joints.method: Recompute sha256 of every artifact bound in the three batches' release/archive records and the two producer task write_scope files directly from the working tree; compare against recorded digests. Never trust a recorded digest as its own evidence (blind re-derivation).

joints.name: intake_contract_compliance
joints.method: Check the three delivered intake files (TASK-20260905-53d333) against contracts/design-intake.json obligations: prerequisite intake for the five proposals, explicit pending proof and benchmark obligations, source-access disclosure, one ranked next design action; note gaps as findings, not verdicts on the science.

joints.name: failure_record_honesty
joints.method: Compare the ae8941/a05748/b6c926 failure records (release notes, queue states, reports) against the underlying artifacts and the two batch reports; flag any claim in a report not supported by an artifact, and any artifact fact absent from the reports.

joints.name: delivery_acceptance_basis
joints.method: Assess whether DEC-20260905-293536's acceptance of operational delivery for TASK-20260905-1134be is supported by BATCH-cef2eb/archives/TASK-20260905-5dd82d/observer.json, and state exactly what that acceptance does and does not establish.

control.description: The J1 recompute-vs-recorded method is applied to BATCH-cef2eb (small, known-good, delivery-diagnostic set) as well as to the failed batches. A method that flags everything or nothing is miscalibrated and must say so.

startup_receipt.when: Written before any archive under review is opened; records session start time, runtime, resolved model identity if exposed, and the task id.

prohibitions: No solver execution, no new benchmarks, no resource-limit changes, no network activity, no Bedrock.
No scientific claim, no goal status change, no promotion of any record.
The blocked ledger stages of BATCH-1a527c and BATCH-971dc7 stay blocked regardless of this review's verdict; unblocking is a separate Coordinator decision.
